newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-Moody's confirms PUMA's AAA P-5 bond rating.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-Moody's confirms PUMA's AAA P-5 bond rating.

text.p: Moody's Investors Service said on Friday it confirmed the AAA ratings assigned to PUMA's Masterfund P-5 senior bonds.
PUMA is the mortgage securitisation operation of Macquarie Bank Ltd MBL.AX.
Moody's said A$1.23 billion of fixed rate and floating rate mortgage-backed securities were affected by the confirmation.

Moody's said the ratings confirmation followed the issue of an additional A$475.0 million of series B senior bonds from Masterfund P-5. This increased the amount on issue to A$1.23 billion from A$756.0 million.
